verifications.claim: Saturday Night Live's 51st season is the 2025–2026 season.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'premiered on October 4, 2025 ... during the 2025-26 television season, ... conclude on May 16, 2026'; R3/R4/R6: Season 51 for 2025-26
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly identify Season 51 as the 2025-2026 season.

verifications.claim: Kenan Thompson is returning for his 23rd season on Saturday Night Live.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Kenan Thompson returns to “Saturday Night Live” for his 23rd season'
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated in R3 with exact season count attributed to Kenan Thompson.

verifications.claim: Colin Jost and Michael Che are Weekend Update anchors on Saturday Night Live.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Colin Jost and Michael Che, the longest-running hosts of “Weekend Update,” will spend their 12th season behind the desk'
verifications.reasoning: Directly confirms their roles as Weekend Update anchors.

verifications.claim: The returning veterans for Saturday Night Live's 51st season (2025–2026) are Kenan Thompson, Bowen Yang, Chloe Fineman, Mikey Day, Colin Jost, Michael Che, Marcello Hernández, Andrew Dismukes, James Austin Johnson, Sarah Sherman, Jane Wickline, Ashley Padilla.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: Lists exactly these as 'Returning': Kenan Thompson, Colin Jost, Michael Che, Bowen Yang, Chloe Fineman, Marcello Hernández, Mikey Day, Sarah Sherman, James Austin Johnson, Andrew Dismukes, Ashley Padilla, Jane Wickline; R4 similar list
verifications.reasoning: Exact match to the list of returning cast in R3 and R4; R2 confirms most returned (Bowen left mid-season but was returning initially).

verifications.claim: Several new featured players joined Saturday Night Live in late 2025.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'On September 2, 2025, five new featured cast members were announced'; season premiered October 4, 2025
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm five new featured players announced/joined for Season 51 starting late 2025 (Sep/Oct 2025); 'late 2025' aligns precisely.

verifications.claim: The new featured players who joined Saturday Night Live season 51 are Ben Marshall (formerly of Please Don't Destroy), Tommy Brennan, Jeremy Culhane, Kam Patterson, and Veronika Slowikowska.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'five new featured cast members were announced: stand-up comic Tommy Brennan, Upright Citizens Brigade performer ... Jeremy Culhane, stand-up comic ... Kam Patterson, social media comedian ... Veronika Slowikowska, and Ben Marshall, SNL staff writer and member of ... Please Don't Destroy'
verifications.reasoning: R2 lists exactly these five as new featured players for Season 51 with Ben Marshall's PDD background.

verifications.claim: Saturday Night Live aired new episodes in early 2026.

verifications.evidence: R2: Episodes listed January 17, 2026; January 24, 2026; January 31, 2026; February 28, 2026
verifications.reasoning: R2 directly lists multiple new episodes in January/February 2026 (early 2026).
